title: Latency Rank Query
source: 230. Kth Smallest Element in a BST
brief: A monitoring service stores response time samples in a binary search tree: every sample in a node's left subtree is faster than the node's, and every sample in its right subtree is slower. Engineers regularly ask for the response time at a particular rank, counting from the fastest.
Implement latencyAtRank(root, k), where root is the TreeNode at the root of the sample tree, each node's value is a response time, and k is the rank requested, and return the response time at rank k.
